title: J&J Expands Cancer Pipeline with $3B Halda Acquisition
summary: Halda says its precision oncology candidates are designed to address the large unmet need of patients with tumors that have developed resistance to existing drugs. The pipeline was developed using Halda’s Regulated Induced Proximity TArgeting Chimera (RIPTAC) platform.The postJ&J Expands Cancer Pipeline with $3B Halda Acquisitionappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
